name: AECi — Retention prune failed (daily cron)
message:
The daily 03:00 UTC §7.4 retention prune (AECI-584) threw. Unlike the snapshot cron, this job does not degrade to partial success: its deletes and the single `retention.pruned` audit row commit in ONE atomic `db.batch`, so a throw means nothing was deleted and nothing was logged — the database is exactly as it was.

Read the `source:retention-prune-cron` log `aeci.retention.crashed` for the reason. Common causes are a missing/failing `DB` binding and a D1 write error. No manual repair is needed for the data; the next night's run re-probes its cutoffs from scratch. If it fails repeatedly the table keeps growing, so treat a sustained failure as a real defect rather than transient.

Note: this monitor deliberately does NOT use notify_no_data — `outcome:failed` is absent on a healthy run, so no-data here would be a constant false alarm. Cron liveness is the companion monitor 'AECi — Retention prune not running'.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#retention-prune-skipped-failed-or-not-running
